title: The Social Cost of Intelligence: Emergence, Propagation, and Amplification of Stereotypical Bias in Multi-Agent Systems
reasoning: The paper evaluates stereotypical bias in Multi-Agent Systems across various social categories, specifically including religion as a core dimension. It uses datasets like BBQ, CrowSPairs, and StereoSet which contain religious stereotypes, and Tables 3 and 5 explicitly list religious groups (Atheist, Christian, Hindu, Muslim) alongside the biases being measured.
